question: In which year was Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana launched in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1999.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)** was launched in India in **1999**.
 
• It is **a poverty alleviation program** aimed at promoting self-employment and sustainable income-generation activities in rural areas.
 
• The nodal ministry is the **Ministry of Rural Development(MoRD).**
 
• The program targets families below the poverty line and provides them with financial assistance, training, and other support to start their own businesses.
 
• SGSY was later **replaced by** the **Aajeevika - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM)** in **2011**, which has a broader scope and aims to cover all rural poor households.
 
 
• NRLM also focuses on building capacities and institutions of the rural poor to enable them to take charge of their own lives and livelihoods.
 
 
 
• It was **renamed** as** DAY-NRLM (Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Livelihoods Mission) **in **2015**.
 
• The program is supported partially by the **World Bank**.
